answer.reason: The verses tell of his appointment by Babylon, his rebellion, and the fall of Jerusalem with his capture and punishment.

clauses.english: was made king by the king of Babylon, who changed his name to Zedekiah
rebelled against the king of Babylon
clauses.quote: Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon

clauses.english: was captured, saw his sons slain, and was blinded and taken to Babylon
clauses.quote: put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him with fetters of brass

doubts: Verses from Jeremiah about prophecies concerning Zedekiah and his dealings with Jeremiah were left out as secondary to the main events.
